prompts.name: creacion
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: landscape editorial illustration for a comparative religion library website. Style: refined painterly digital illustration, deep midnight blue, warm parchment gold, realistic textures, dramatic but restrained lighting, respectful mythological imagery. Wide 3:2 landscape composition, no text, no letters, no watermarks, no logos. Standalone finished image. Theme: LA CREACION, shared creation motifs. Show primordial dark ocean beneath an empty cosmic sky, a brilliant golden beam of first light opening through darkness and defining a new horizon, a mound of new earth rising from the waters, a subtle lotus and a long serpent upon the water. Depict the shared motifs of Egyptian Nun, Hindu cosmic waters and Shesha, Maya creation by word and Genesis light over the waters. Harmonious coherent scene, symbolic rather than presenting a single deity as belonging to every religion.

prompts.name: infierno
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: landscape editorial illustration for a comparative religion library website. Style: refined painterly digital illustration, deep midnight blue, warm parchment gold, realistic textures, dramatic but restrained lighting, respectful mythological imagery. Wide 3:2 landscape composition, no text, no letters, no watermarks, no logos. Standalone finished image. Theme: EL INFIERNO, shared underworld motifs. Show a solemn cavernous underworld with a dark red river and a narrow stone bridge descending toward ancient stone doorways. One shadowy dog guards the passage, distant roots and a restrained serpentine dragon silhouette, sharp obsidian-like rock formations. Evoke Hel, Naraka, Xibalba and Duat through darkness, dangerous waters, guardians and paths. No suffering bodies, no gore, no torture, no horned cartoon devil. Rich atmospheric depth and readable uncluttered composition.

prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: landscape editorial illustration for a comparative religion library website. Style: refined painterly digital illustration, deep midnight blue, warm parchment gold, realistic textures, dramatic but restrained lighting, respectful mythological imagery. Wide 3:2 landscape composition, no text, no letters, no watermarks, no logos. Standalone finished image. Theme: EL FIN / APOCALIPSIS, destruction and cosmic renewal.
